candidate.name: Dalgaranga Meteorite Crater
candidate.note: Meteorite crater: 24 m across and 3 m deep, Australia's smallest impact crater, on Dalgaranga station; daylight access, signposted, no facilities. Sits about 75 km west of Mount Magnet and 100 km north of Yalgoo, so it may fall in the Murchison (golden-outback) region; the proposer should resolve. [Moved from wa-coral-coast at reconciliation: the Murchison inland is wa-golden-outback (wa-regions.md).]
